why.en: Shows the address, gateway, DNS server and lease times your own machine got from DHCP.
why.hinglish: Dikhata hai ki tumhari machine ko DHCP se kaunsa address, gateway, DNS server aur lease times mile.

expect.en: On Windows look for DHCP Server, Lease Obtained and Lease Expires. On macOS the getpacket output lists the offered options. Values differ per machine and network; the DHCP server is usually your router, e.g. 192.168.1.1.
expect.hinglish: Windows par DHCP Server, Lease Obtained aur Lease Expires dhoondo. macOS par getpacket output mein offered options dikhte hain. Values machine aur network ke hisaab se alag hongi; DHCP server aam taur par tumhara router hota hai, jaise 192.168.1.1.

why.en: A 169.254.x.x address means DHCP failed and the machine used APIPA.
why.hinglish: 169.254.x.x address ka matlab DHCP fail hua aur machine ne APIPA use kiya.

expect.en: On a healthy network you will see a normal private address (192.168.x.x or 10.x.x.x). A 169.254 address would show the no-server scenario. Output varies by machine.
expect.hinglish: Healthy network par normal private address (192.168.x.x ya 10.x.x.x) dikhega. 169.254 address no-server scenario dikhata. Output machine ke hisaab se alag hota hai.

title.en: Find the DORA packets in the capture

why.en: Open the downloaded .pcap in Wireshark and filter for DHCP traffic.
why.hinglish: Download kiya hua .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur DHCP traffic filter karo.

expect.en: You should see Discover, Offer, Request and ACK, with the options (gateway, DNS, lease time) inside the Offer and ACK.
expect.hinglish: Discover, Offer, Request aur ACK dikhne chahiye, aur Offer tatha ACK ke andar options (gateway, DNS, lease time) honge.

why.en: Filter on DHCP message type 1 (DISCOVER) sent from 0.0.0.0.
why.hinglish: DHCP message type 1 (DISCOVER) par filter karo jo 0.0.0.0 se bheja gaya.

expect.en: One packet from 0.0.0.0:68 to 255.255.255.255:67, matching the first step.
expect.hinglish: 0.0.0.0:68 se 255.255.255.255:67 tak ek packet, jo pehle step se match karta hai.
